name: v0.2.3 — Update System UX Overhaul
body:
## Update System UX Overhaul

A major redesign of the in-app update flow — clearer layout, in-button progress, downloaded-state tracking, and auto-cleanup of stale APKs.

### UpdateBottomSheet redesign
- Bold theme-colored heading **'New Update Available'** at the top
- Version + release date shown just below the heading
- Dedicated **'What's New'** changelog section inside a card
- Download + X (cancel) buttons on the **same row** at the bottom
- Download button transforms into an **in-button progress bar** (fill animation)
- Shows **'Install Update'** when the APK is already downloaded (no re-download)

### AboutScreen redesign
- Removed the always-on update info card (updates only show as a bottom sheet)
- Manual **'Check for updates'** now triggers the bottom sheet when an update is found
- Downloaded versions: only shows files that **actually exist** on disk
- Downloaded versions: added a **Delete button** (trash icon) per row
- Downloaded versions: Install button now uses primary color + install icon

### AppUpdateManager improvements
- `isLatestUpdateDownloaded()` — check if the APK file exists for the current update
- `getDownloadedApkPath()` — get the file path for the downloaded APK
- `deleteDownloadedApk()` — delete file from disk + remove record
- `cleanupOldDownloads()` — auto-delete APKs for versions <= current

### AppUpdatePreferences improvements
- `deleteDownloadedApk()` — deletes file + removes record
- `isVersionDownloaded()` — checks if APK exists for a version
- `getDownloadedApkPath()` — gets path for a version's APK
- `clearDismissCooldown()` — for testing (always show update dialog)

### AnikutaRoot startup
- Clears dismiss cooldown on startup (always show update dialog for testing)
- Calls `cleanupOldDownloads()` to free storage
- Immediate check on app open (no 6h cooldown during testing)

### Version bump
- `0.2.2` (code 4) -> `0.2.3` (code 5)

---

**Install manually** to test the update loop:
1. Install this APK
2. Open the app — update bottom sheet appears immediately
3. Tap Download -> in-button progress -> Install
4. Repeat (the test target release `v0.3.0` always appears as an update)
